page.overview:
Who is Royder?

Royder is a reporter who witnessed and reported on the events of the Summit War of Marineford from Sabaody Archipelago.

Royder is a middle-aged man. He has black hair and a stubbly goatee of the same color. He sports a beige newsboy cap. He wears a gray jacket with a white dress shirt underneath with a loose red tie. He also wears matching gray slacks and a brown belt.

33 years ago, Royder was a young man with a leaner build and no facial hair. He wore a dark shirt, a plaid vest, a light jacket, and a light newsboy cap with his name written on it.

Royder, like most people, was very terrified that Ace was Roger's son and of the power that was present at the Summit War of Marineford. As a young man, he was no less shocked when he received news of what Harald had done.
